sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?continentLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P30 ?continent .
  ?continent rdfs:label ?continentLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?continentLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?taxaLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_APPROACH ?approach .
  ?approach rdfs:label ?approachLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?approachLabel)), "observational"))
  ?contribution orkgp:P39141 ?taxa .
  ?taxa rdfs:label ?taxaLabel .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?scaleLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P115002 ?scale .
  ?scale rdfs:label ?scaleLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?scaleLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?duration
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P15594 ?duration .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?countryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  VALUES ?link1 { orkgp:P115000 orkgp:wikidata:P2974 }
  ?paperContribution ?link1 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65002 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P37524 ?country .
  ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?countryLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

SELECT ?habitatLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?count)

  ?contribution a orkgc:C65002 .

SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?sourceLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P112020 ?source .
  ?source rdfs:label ?sourceLabel .
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?heightValue ?unitLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P71179 ?h .
  ?h orkgp:P71048 ?heightValue .
  OPTIONAL { ?h orkgp:P42000 ?unit . ?unit rdfs:label ?unitLabel }
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>

SELECT ?countryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?paper) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P17 ?country .
  ?country rdfs:label ?countryLabel .
}

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel
WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P149068 ?rose .
  ?rose rdfs:label ?roseLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?roseLabel)) = "yes")
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

WHERE {
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C92000 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P149067 ?ts .
  ?ts orkgp:P45075 ?numTS .
  OPTIONAL { ?ts orkgp:P45076 ?unit . ?unit rdfs:label ?unitLabel }

ORDER BY ?paperLabel

SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?areaLabel

  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  ?contribution orkgp:P134011 ?disease .
  ?disease rdfs:label ?diseaseLabel .
  FILTER(LCASE(STR(?diseaseLabel)) = "obesity")

  ?area rdfs:label ?areaLabel .

}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
